proposal.summary: Record that update-client batch 1 contract skeletons implement the interface-first boundary without production update runtime.

future_considerations: Define machine-readable signed manifest schema examples and public-key rotation policy before network runtime.
Choose HTTP/update-server retry and offline-cache policy before adding a real client.
Add artifact extraction and filesystem staging fixtures before any artifact staging runtime.
Bind rollback/preflight to backup package evidence before installer mutation runtime.
Keep installer orchestration in a separate launch record with explicit mutation approvals.
